notes.title: Postal 3: Update #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953270/930a431c9d82075f2bd6b55e849ce5e1356a1328.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953270/413a9c083004ba97f790023e4d908d9d25cacf49.png[/img]


- Added Fart Gun DLC [i](for real this time!)[/i]

- Added mod support!
[list]
[*] Non destructive! You no longer have to replace files, which means no more re-downloading the entire game when something breaks
[*] Ability to install multiple mods at the same time and easily toggle them on and off
[*] Configurable load order
[*] For modders, check out [i]"p3/addons/readme.txt"[/i] for more info
[*] Special thanks to [i][b]ABRAoriginal & Jack Procter[/b][/i] for testing and valuable input!
[/list]
- Added the ability to set the language via the [i]"-language {language}"[/i] flag

- Added Brazilian Portuguese localization by [i][b]AlgumOtario[/b][/i]

- Added French localization by [i][b]Nesskbl[/b][/i]

- Re-introduced and updated German localization

- Updated [i]"Slave 'Boy' Escort"[/i] level script to allow NPC to be human shieldable to avoid softlocks

- Fixed crashes that occurred when loading some maps

- Fixed upgrade indicator on weapon selector

- Fixed unreadable main menu when using lower texture settings

- Fixed incorrect cutscene playing after finishing [i]"Police Academy"[/i]

- Fixed placeholder audio on some English cutscenes

- Fixed wall texture issue in "Porn World" [i][b](Thanks, ABRAoriginal!)[/b][/i]

- Fixed [i]"Real American"[/i] & [i]"Kavorkian"[/i] achievements [i][b](Thanks, ABRAoriginal & Kizoky!)[/b][/i]

- Removed incompetent framerate cap

- Removed [i]"custom"[/i] folder, superseded by proper mod support

- Added the official Japanese localization, cleaned up a bit by [i][b]ZOOM Platform[/b][/i]

- Added the Japanese digital manual and high res scans of the synopsis booklet and Catharsis map as bonus content

- Added the Postal III Official Soundtrack & Music to go POSTAL By. Downloadable as FLAC or 320kbps MP3. [i][b]Thanks to Allard for supplying the discs![/b][/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2674620/Postal_3__Official_Soundtrack/

In order to download the FLAC OST, you need to make sure the “Download high quality music” setting is enabled in Steam’s Music settings. 

- Fixed mission-specific loading screens not working for most of the levels

- Actually replaced placeholder [i]"Slave 'Boy' Escort"[/i] starting cutscene with the correct one

- Fixed [i]"Gay Rodeo"[/i] ending cutscenes

- Minor adjustments to all localisations

- Added Polish localization by [i][b]JakX2[/b][/i] & [i][b]ArtekXDPL[/b][/i]

- Added a recreated detail.vbsp by [i][b]ABRAoriginal[/b][/i] to help mappers add foliage to their maps

- Fixed ragdolls & blood flow positions for elderly models. [i][b](Thanks, RidiculousRobot!)[/b][/i]

- Fixed a chunky skybox texture by enabling texture filtering [i][b](Thanks, Lena!)[/b][/i]

notes.title: Postal 3: 'No DRM' Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953270/691fe4029b23946dc41427da4ecd59f847dfa7b2.png[/img]

Months ago, Valve removed Postal III due to issues with DRM. Despite being a dark chapter in the series, people should still be able to check the game out if they want. We did what we could to make it happen.

Featuring 100% less DRM [i](and a couple less crashes)[/i] for new and existing customers, Postal III is now back on Steam!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953270/413a9c083004ba97f790023e4d908d9d25cacf49.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953270/00ee056c19557b6a6ed0caf626d986b9fe799a98.png[/img]
